The verifier assumes that map values are simple blobs of memory
therefore treats ARG_PTR_TO_MAP_VALUE
map types where this isn't true. For example
sockets. In general this isn't a big problem: we can just
write helpers that explicitly requests PTR_TO_SOCKET instead of
ARG_PTR_TO_MAP_VALUE.
The one exception are the standard map helpers like map_update_elem
map_lookup_elem
column2: etc. Here it would be nice we could overload the

column1: function prototype for different kinds of maps. Unfortunately
isn't entirely straight forward:
We only know the type of the map once we have resolved meta->map_ptr
in check_func_arg. This means we can't swap out the prototype
in check_helper_call until we're half way through the function.
Instead
column2: modify check_func_arg to treat ARG_PTR_TO_MAP_VALUE to

column1: mean ""the native type for the map"" instead of ""pointer to memory""
for sockmap and sockhash. This means we don't have to modify the
function prototype at all
